About the lodge

The Ridge Park Lodge is a lodge in Mafemani-B, set among trees and lawns with two swimming pools, a paved pool deck, shaded seating and a covered pergola. Stay in a comfortable double room, or spend a day relaxing by the water.

Questions

How do I book?

Use the Book section, choose your room, stay and date, then send the inquiry on WhatsApp. We reply to confirm availability.

What are the rates?

Rates are given on request. Send an inquiry and we will reply with prices.

Is there a swimming pool?

Yes, the lodge has two swimming pools with a paved deck and shaded seating.
